proof_body:
by
  intro A _ n _ _ _ P
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨i0⟩ := ‹Nonempty n›
    refine ⟨P i0 i0, ?_⟩
    have hdiag : ∀ i j : n, P i i = P j j := by
      intro i j
      have h1 := congrFun (congrFun (h (Matrix.single i j (1 : A))) i) j
      rw [Matrix.mul_single_apply_same, Matrix.single_mul_apply_same] at h1
      simpa using h1
    have hoff : ∀ i j : n, i ≠ j → P i j = 0 := by
      intro i j hij
      have h1 := congrFun (congrFun (h (Matrix.single j j (1 : A))) i) j
      rw [Matrix.mul_single_apply_same, Matrix.single_mul_apply_of_ne (1 : A) j j i j hij P] at h1
      simpa using h1
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      simp [Matrix.scalar_apply, hdiag i i0]
    · simp [Matrix.scalar_apply, hij, hoff i j hij]
  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩ Q
    exact Matrix.scalar_commute r (fun _ => mul_comm _ _) Q
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [CommRing A] (n : Type*) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty n] (P : Matrix n n A), (∀ Q : Matrix n n A, P * Q = Q * P) ↔ ∃ r : A, P = Matrix.scalar n r
